evidence.reason: In the health branch of the broad except handler, deploy-controller.py no longer re-raises OSError/ValueError/CalledProcessError from a failed health observation; it now emits the I1 error artifact (_error_artifact kind 'thrown', subcommand 'health', exitCode 1) on stdout — keeping stderr narration only outside --json — and returns 1, so every health invocation still exits under the health exit-1 contract but with machine-readable JSON on stdout per doctrine I1.
